comment: Equipment definitions in FEET. `length` is the feed axis - material runs that way through the machine - and `width` is across it.

items.label: Marvel Series 81 band saw
items.note: Marvel 81 / M2 / M3 series - vertical tilt-frame saw. Material feeds through the 5' side, so the 8' dimension runs across the material path. Footprint is the rough figure given, not a spec sheet. The frame tilts for mitres, which needs its own side clearance - not modelled yet.

items.label: Forklift
items.note: Counterbalance truck. Length includes the forks; height is the mast lowered. Travel paths come in Phase 5.

items.label: Material rack
items.note: Cantilever rack: 20' of frame in 5' bays, arms 4' apart, 5' deep. Holds 24' stock, which overhangs 2' each end.

items.label: 10' press brake
items.note: Bed length is the 10' given. Depth, height and clearances are typical figures, not a spec sheet - say the word and they get trued up.

clearance.label: 8' operator side for the sheet, 3' behind

items.label: 12' hydraulic shear
items.note: Bed length is the 12' given. Depth, height and clearances are typical figures, not a spec sheet - say the word and they get trued up.

clearance.label: 10' to load the sheet, 5' behind for the drop
